effectsComparison.boundary: UI Rendering callbacks and GDI capture brackets are measured separately. Screenshot may reflect a previous compositor frame. Browser replay uses native wall-clock action times; no clock fitting or native from-value injection. Pixel and exact present-time equivalence are not accepted.

materialBackends.boundary: Local acrylic region excludes label/button text; downsampled GPU Gaussian is approximate, not native pixel equivalence.

wallClock.boundary: UI and compositor captures have different present latency; no clock fitting applied.

fixedProgress.boundary: Native protected effect controllers are paused only by the probe. Browser uses public SDK and the same normalized animation progress.

acceptTiming.boundary: Per-backend normalized settled-glyph mask coverage, not identical rasterization. Native foreground capture timestamps bracket compositor presentation; browser uses deterministic Rust time. Coalesced native case is a diagnostic sequence of attached-state setters, not OS pointer input.

limits: Frame percentiles cover synchronous WASM, submission and DOM projection; not GPU execution time.
Fence polling reports an upper bound to completion of queued GPU commands, not per-frame GPU execution. Timer-query capability is recorded but no GPU timing claim is made.
Chrome JS heap estimate omits GPU allocations and is not a process RSS/WASM memory inventory.
Three local trials are observational; not a hardware performance guarantee.

limitations: HighContrast Button comparisons use matching deterministic resource fixtures, not a change to the user OS accessibility configuration.
InputProbe validates Chromium IME composition and DOM anchor placement; OS candidate-window appearance and screen-reader acceptance are not established.
Dev-server local measurements, not a controlled cold-start benchmark.
Frame timings include synchronous WASM, Canvas submission and accessibility DOM work; Phase-5 GPU paint elapsed queries are measured separately; OS process CPU and total VRAM are not measured.

Static native/browser captures use matched 1000x500 DIP, DPR 1 (progress probes: 1.25) and per-case inputs. RenderTargetBitmap may differ from the live compositor, especially Acrylic/AnimatedIcon; native pixel parity is not accepted.

Native animation captures take about 150ms each; timestamp intervals are preserved. Phase-5 adds UI Rendering callback properties and bracketed GDI pixels; neither establishes precise compositor-present equivalence.
